question: Should OpenClaw permanently add `append: true` to the built-in write tool and `appendFile?` to the sandbox/plugin bridge contract?
rationale: The implementation addresses a real data-loss class and appears technically correct, but both additions become durable model-facing and plugin compatibility contracts that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept both APIs
options.body: Sponsor and reopen the capability-gated write parameter and optional bridge method as the canonical additive contract.

options.title: Keep append internal
options.body: Use native append only for selected memory or workflow paths without exposing a general model-facing or plugin API.

options.title: Defer append support
options.body: Leave the candidate closed until maintainers select a different durable file-mutation contract.

recommendation.title: Accept both APIs
recommendation.body: Sponsor and reopen the capability-gated write parameter and optional bridge method as the canonical additive contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent ownership signal across the complete write and sandbox mutation surface is the refactor commit attributed to this login.
